scope: GPT reconstructed and hash-checked 16 supplied source/evidence blocks, ran actual Python harness functions with isolated controlled source/cycle fixtures, and decoded/hash-matched the two supplied native boss images. GPT did NOT rerun Godot or the complete 101-test Python suite.
routingObservations: Seven positive conditions behaved as expected; three expected-result mismatches represented two concrete harness bugs.

findings.issue: E source approvals do not preserve E full-cycle review priority over non-E cycle repair
counterexamples: E seven sources approved + E needs_cycle_review + SE repair selects SE/walk/3
E seven sources approved + E stale_cycle_review + SE repair selects SE/walk/3
findings.minimumFix: Preserve explicit source repair and incomplete pilot source priorities; next handle E/walk pending/repair cycle in isolation before non-E followups. Keep approved-E positive SE repair behavior.

findings.issue: Shared prepareCycleReview command drops the selected run action and CLI defaults to walk
findings.counterexample: Separate run recipe chooses SE/run with nextSource.command --action run, but commands.prepareCycleReview omits action; actual CLI parser passes walk to preview callback; faulty packet still verifies CURRENT_HANDOFF
findings.minimumFix: Carry selected action from cycle or slot, map idle to walk for gait review, emit explicit --action, and test actual CLI dispatch for walk and run.

imageObservations: First image is phase2 warning with ASTER96/96; second is phase3 impact with ASTER56/96. GPT did not treat these as one attack before/after. Same-case HP changes were separately read in supplied reports.
